Metadata.title: Killua Zoldyck
Metadata.description: An animated portfolio dedicated to Killua Zoldyck from Hunter x Hunter.

ZoldyckFamily.label: The family
ZoldyckFamily.intro: The most feared family of assassins in the world. They live in their estate on Kukuroo Mountain, and every child is trained to kill from an early age. Killua is the third child.

zeno.description: Former head of the family and a legendary assassin. In battle, his Nen takes the shape of a dragon.

silva.description: The current head of the family. Killua got his white hair and his talent from him.

kikyo.description: Always wears a visor over her eyes. She dreams of Killua becoming the greatest assassin in the family.

illumi.description: Cold and emotionless. He uses needles to control people, even his own brother.

milluki.description: The computer genius. He prefers to stay shut in at home among his screens and collections.

killua.description: The heir chosen by the family. He runs away from home to become a Hunter with his friend Gon.

alluka.description: Holds a mysterious power the family fears. Killua is the only one who protects her.

kalluto.description: Always wears a kimono and fights with paper fans.
